title: Badiiy matn tahlili
goal_uz: Dars oxirida badiiy parchadagi mavzu va obrazlarni aniqlaysiz, hikoyachi ovozini tavsiflaysiz, uslubiy vositalarning ta’sirini tushuntirasiz va dalilli qisqa tahlil abzatsini yozasiz.

scenes.title: Adabiy matnni o‘qish
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda media va jurnalistika bilan ishladik, u yerda til faktni yetkazar edi. Bugun esa til his va ma’no yaratadigan joyga o‘tamiz: badiiy matn. Dars oxirida siz parchadagi mavzu va obrazlarni topasiz, hikoyachi ovozini tasvirlaysiz, uslubiy vositalar qanday ta’sir qilishini tushuntirasiz va kichik tahlil abzatsini yozasiz. Bu ko‘nikma IELTS, Cambridge C1 va universitetdagi o‘qish uchun ham kerak. Asosiy qoida: matn nima deydi emas, matn buni qanday aytadi, shunga e’tibor beramiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time we dealt with the media, where language delivers facts. Today we turn to literature, where language creates feeling and meaning. You will find themes and imagery, describe a narrator's voice, explain how devices work and write a short analytical paragraph.
scenes.say_uz: Qaytganingizdan xursandman. O‘tgan safar media bilan ishladik, u yerda til faktni yetkazadi. Bugun adabiyotga o‘tamiz, u yerda til his va ma’no yaratadi. Mavzu va obrazlarni topasiz, hikoyachi ovozini tasvirlaysiz, vositalar qanday ishlashini tushuntirasiz va qisqa tahlil abzatsini yozasiz.

scenes.title: Mavzu va obrazlar
board: Theme = an idea about life, not a topic
Imagery = language that appeals to the senses

examples.t: The poem explores the idea that patience is a form of strength.
examples.uz: She’r sabr kuchning bir shakli degan fikrni o‘rganadi.

examples.t: The imagery of cold, grey rain creates a feeling of loneliness.
examples.uz: Sovuq, kulrang yomg‘ir tasviri yolg‘izlik hissini yaratadi.

examples.t: The smell of bread suggests warmth and home.
examples.uz: Non hidi iliqlik va uyni eslatadi.

scenes.say_native: Mavzu — bu hayot haqidagi fikr, oddiy topic emas. Masalan, „war“ — topic, „war destroys innocence“ — mavzu. Mavzuni shunday ifodalang: „The poem explores the idea that patience is a form of strength“. „Explore“ — o‘rganmoq, tadqiq qilmoq. Obraz, ya’ni „imagery“ — sezgilarga ta’sir qiluvchi til: ko‘rish, eshitish, teginish, hid va ta’m. „Cold, grey rain“ ko‘rish va teginish obrazi bo‘lib, yolg‘izlik hissini yaratadi. Tahlilda „bu so‘zlar yomg‘irni tasvirlaydi“ deb to‘xtamang, „yolg‘izlikni uyg‘otadi“ deb ta’sirini ayting. O‘zbek adabiyotidagi „g‘oya“ va „mavzu“ ni ham ajrating: mavzu — nima haqida, g‘oya — nima demoqchi.
scenes.say: A theme is an idea about life, not just a topic. War is a topic. War destroys innocence is a theme. Say: the poem explores the idea that patience is a form of strength. Imagery is language that appeals to the senses. The imagery of cold, grey rain creates a feeling of loneliness. The smell of bread suggests warmth and home.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu — hayot haqidagi fikr, oddiy topic emas. Urush — topic, urush begunohlikni yo‘q qiladi — mavzu. Obraz sezgilarga ta’sir qiluvchi tildir. Sovuq, kulrang yomg‘ir tasviri yolg‘izlik hissini yaratadi.

scenes.title: Xato: syujetni qayta aytish
board: ✗ The poem is about a river.
✓ The poem uses a river to explore patience.
✓ The soft sounds create a calm mood.

examples.t: The poem uses a river to explore the theme of patience.
examples.uz: She’r sabr mavzusini ochish uchun daryodan foydalanadi.

examples.t: The long, soft vowels create a calm, slow mood.
examples.uz: Uzun, yumshoq unlilar sokin, sekin kayfiyat yaratadi.

scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato — matn nima haqida ekanini oddiy aytib qo‘yish: „The poem is about a river“. Bu syujet, tahlil emas. Daryo nimaning ramzi, u qanday g‘oyani ochadi? „The poem uses a river to explore patience.“ Ikkinchi xato — „nice words“, „beautiful language“ kabi bo‘sh baholar. Buning o‘rniga ta’sirni aniq ayting: „The long, soft vowels create a calm, slow mood“. Uchinchi xato — hamma narsani ramz deb talqin qilish. Har bir deraza ramz emas; dalil bo‘lsa, ramz deng. Bu ko‘nikma o‘zbek maktabidagi „asar mazmunini so‘zlab bering“ topshirig‘idan farq qiladi, chunki bu yerda sizdan so‘zlab berish emas, tahlil kutiladi.
scenes.say: The most common mistake is to retell the plot: the poem is about a river. That is content, not analysis. Ask what the river stands for. The poem uses a river to explore patience. Another weak habit is empty praise, like nice words. Name the effect instead: the long, soft vowels create a calm, slow mood.
scenes.say_uz: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato — syujetni qayta aytish. Bu tahlil emas. Daryo nimani ifodalashini so‘rang. Yana bir kuchsiz odat — bo‘sh maqtov. Buning o‘rniga ta’sirni nomlang: uzun, yumshoq unlilar sokin, sekin kayfiyat yaratadi.

scenes.title: Mashq: parchadagi mavzu va obraz
board: The house had been waiting for them for years. Dust lay on the piano like a held breath, and the clock in the hall, stopped at ten past three, kept its secret.
scenes.say_native: Parchani tinglang. Uy yillar davomida ularni kutgan edi. Pianino ustida chang ushlab turilgan nafasdek yotardi, zaldagi soat uch dan o‘n daqiqa o‘tganda to‘xtab, o‘z sirini saqlardi. Ikki savol: qanday obrazlar bor va ular qanday mavzuni ochadi? Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Listen to the extract. The house had been waiting for them for years. Dust lay on the piano like a held breath, and the clock in the hall, stopped at ten past three, kept its secret. What imagery do you notice, and what theme does it suggest?
scenes.say_uz: Parchani tinglang. Uy yillar davomida ularni kutgan edi. Pianino ustida chang ushlab turilgan nafasdek yotardi, zaldagi uch dan o‘n daqiqa o‘tganda to‘xtagan soat o‘z sirini saqlardi. Qanday obrazlar bor va ular qanday mavzuni bildiradi?

scenes.title: Javob: uy va to‘xtagan soat

examples.t: The stopped clock suggests that time froze at a moment of loss.
examples.uz: To‘xtagan soat vaqt yo‘qotish lahzasida qotib qolganini ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob: „The imagery of dust, silence and a stopped clock creates a feeling of stillness and absence. The clock suggests that time froze at a moment of loss, so the extract explores the theme of memory and the past.“ Obrazlar asosan ko‘rish va sukunat bilan bog‘liq. „Held breath“ — ushlab turilgan nafas — kutish va tarang jimlikni bildiradi. „Stillness“ — harakatsizlik, „absence“ — yo‘qlik. E’tibor bering, javobda avval obraz, keyin ta’sir, keyin mavzu keladi. Sizning javobingizda kamida bitta aniq so‘z va uning ta’siri bo‘lsa, to‘g‘ri bajargansiz.
scenes.say: A model answer. The imagery of dust, silence and a stopped clock creates a feeling of stillness and absence. The clock suggests that time froze at a moment of loss, so the extract explores memory and the past. Notice the order: image, effect, theme. A held breath hints at tense, waiting silence.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javob. Chang, sukunat va to‘xtagan soat obrazlari harakatsizlik va yo‘qlik hissini yaratadi. Soat vaqt yo‘qotish lahzasida qotib qolganini ko‘rsatadi, shuning uchun parcha xotira va o‘tmishni o‘rganadi. Tartibga e’tibor bering: obraz, ta’sir, mavzu.

scenes.title: Hikoyachi ovozi
board: first person: I · second person: you

examples.t: The first-person narrator lets us see only what she feels.
examples.uz: Birinchi shaxsdagi hikoyachi bizga faqat uning his qilganini ko‘rsatadi.

examples.t: An omniscient narrator knows what every character is thinking.
examples.uz: Hamma narsani biluvchi hikoyachi har bir qahramonning o‘ylarini biladi.

examples.t: The detached tone makes the cruelty even more shocking.
examples.uz: Befarq ohang shafqatsizlikni yanada sarosimali qiladi.

scenes.say_native: Hikoyachi — matnni bizga yetkazuvchi ovoz. Birinchi shaxs „I“ bilan aytiladi va faqat bir kishining nuqtai nazarini beradi. Uchinchi shaxs cheklangan bo‘lsa, hikoyachi bitta qahramonga yaqin turadi. „Omniscient“ hikoyachi esa hamma narsani biladi, har bir qahramonning ichki dunyosini ko‘ra oladi. „Unreliable narrator“ — ishonchsiz hikoyachi: u yolg‘on gapirishi, xato qilishi yoki o‘zini oqlashi mumkin. Ohang, ya’ni „tone“ ham muhim: „wry“ — istehzoli, „bitter“ — achchiq, „nostalgic“ — sog‘inch bilan, „detached“ — befarq. Befarq ohang shafqatsiz voqeani yanada g‘alati qilib ko‘rsatishi mumkin. Hikoyachi va muallifni aralashtirmang.
scenes.say: The narrator is the voice that tells the story. A first-person narrator uses I and shows only one point of view. In third person limited, the narrator stays close to one character. An omniscient narrator knows everyone's thoughts. An unreliable narrator may lie, or be mistaken. Tone matters too: wry, bitter, nostalgic or detached.
scenes.say_uz: Hikoyachi — voqeani aytuvchi ovoz. Birinchi shaxs bitta nuqtai nazarni beradi. Uchinchi shaxs cheklangan bo‘lsa, hikoyachi bitta qahramonga yaqin turadi. Omniscient hikoyachi hammaning o‘ylarini biladi. Unreliable hikoyachi yolg‘on gapirishi yoki adashishi mumkin. Ohang ham muhim.

scenes.title: Xato: muallif va hikoyachi
board: ✓ The narrator expresses resentment towards her mother.

examples.t: The narrator expresses resentment towards her mother.
examples.uz: Hikoyachi onasiga nisbatan ranjish bildiradi.

examples.t: We should question whether the narrator is telling the whole truth.
examples.uz: Hikoyachi to‘liq haqiqatni aytyaptimi, degan savol qo‘yishimiz kerak.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi xato — muallifni hikoyachi bilan aralashtirish. „The author hates her mother“ deb yozmang, chunki hikoyachi — muallif yaratgan ovoz. To‘g‘risi: „The narrator expresses resentment towards her mother“. „Resentment“ — ichki norozilik. Ikkinchi xato — hikoyachining har bir so‘ziga ishonish. Agar u o‘zini doim oqlasa, o‘quvchi shubha qilishi kerak: „We should question whether the narrator is telling the whole truth“. Uchinchi xato — hikoyachini aniq belgilamasdan „the writer“ deyish. O‘zbekcha „muallif aytadiki“ iborasi ko‘pincha hikoyachini ham o‘z ichiga oladi, inglizcha tahlilda ularni aniq ajrating.
scenes.say: One mistake is to confuse the author with the narrator. Do not write the author hates her mother. Write the narrator expresses resentment towards her mother, because the narrator is a voice the author created. Another is to trust every word. If a narrator always defends herself, we should question whether she is telling the whole truth.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi xato — muallif bilan hikoyachini aralashtirish. Muallif onasini yomon ko‘radi deb yozmang, hikoyachi ranjish bildiradi deng. Boshqa xato — hikoyachining har so‘ziga ishonish. U doim o‘zini oqlasa, haqiqatni to‘liq aytyaptimi, deb shubha qiling.

scenes.title: Mashq: hikoyachini tavsiflang
board: I should say at once that I am not a reliable man. Everyone tells me so, usually while I am explaining why they are wrong.
scenes.say_native: Parchani tinglang va uch savolga javob bering: hikoya qaysi shaxsda, ohang qanday va hikoyachiga ishonsa bo‘ladimi? Parcha: „Darhol aytishim kerak, men ishonchli odam emasman. Hamma shunday deydi, odatda men ularning nega noto‘g‘riligini tushuntirayotgan paytimda.“ Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Listen to this extract. I should say at once that I am not a reliable man. Everyone tells me so, usually while I am explaining why they are wrong. Answer three questions. What person is it written in? What is the tone? Can we trust the narrator?
scenes.say_uz: Parchani tinglang. Darhol aytishim kerak, men ishonchli odam emasman. Hamma shunday deydi, odatda men ularning nega noto‘g‘riligini tushuntirayotgan paytimda. Uch savol: qaysi shaxsda yozilgan? Ohang qanday? Hikoyachiga ishonsa bo‘ladimi?

scenes.title: Javob: ishonchsiz hikoyachi
board: 3) probably unreliable: he admits it, yet blames others

examples.t: The narrator admits he is unreliable, yet he blames everyone else.
examples.uz: Hikoyachi ishonchsiz ekanini tan oladi, lekin hammani ayblaydi.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi: parcha birinchi shaxsda yozilgan, „I“ ishlatilgan. Ikkinchi: ohang istehzoli va o‘zini biluvchi, „wry“ va „self-aware“. Uchinchi: hikoyachi, ehtimol, ishonchsiz. U buni o‘zi tan oladi, lekin keyin „they are wrong“ deb hammani ayblaydi, ya’ni o‘zini haq deb biladi. Mana shu qarama-qarshilik uni ishonchsiz qiladi. „Admit“ — tan olmoq, „blame“ — ayblamoq. Javobda „probably“ so‘zi muhim: ishonchsizlikni aniq isbot qilolmaymiz, shuning uchun ehtiyotkor so‘z ishlatamiz. Siz uch savolga dalil bilan javob bergan bo‘lsangiz, bajargansiz.
scenes.say: One: first person, because of the word I. Two: the tone is wry and self-aware. Three: the narrator is probably unreliable. He admits it himself, yet he still blames everyone else, which shows he thinks he is right. Notice the cautious word probably. We cannot prove unreliability from two sentences, so we hedge.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: birinchi shaxs, chunki I so‘zi bor. Ikki: ohang istehzoli va o‘zini biluvchi. Uch: hikoyachi, ehtimol, ishonchsiz. U buni o‘zi tan oladi, lekin hammani ayblaydi. Probably so‘ziga e’tibor bering: ikki gapdan ishonchsizlikni isbotlab bo‘lmaydi.

scenes.title: Uslubiy vositalar
board: Device + effect: it creates / emphasises / mirrors

examples.t: Dust lay on the piano like a held breath.
examples.uz: Pianino ustida chang ushlab turilgan nafasdek yotardi.

examples.t: The city swallowed him whole.
examples.uz: Shahar uni butunlay yutib yubordi.

examples.t: The silent street slept under a soft, silver sky.
examples.uz: Jimjit ko‘cha yumshoq, kumush osmon ostida uxlardi.

scenes.say_native: Eng kerakli vositalarni eslaymiz. „Simile“ — qiyoslash, „like“ yoki „as“ bilan: „like a held breath“. „Metaphor“ — to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri tenglashtirish: „The city is a jungle“. „Personification“ — jonsiz narsaga inson xususiyatini berish: „The city swallowed him whole“. „Alliteration“ — bir xil undosh tovushni takrorlash: „silent… slept… soft… silver… sky“, bu yerda „s“ tovushi sokinlik tuyg‘usini kuchaytiradi. „Irony“ — aytilgan va nazarda tutilgan narsa orasidagi farq. „Symbolism“ — narsaning chuqur ma’noni bildirishi. Muhim: vositani atash yetmaydi, uning ta’sirini ham ayting. Bu o‘zbek tilidagi „tashbeh“, „jonlantirish“ va „alliteratsiya“ ga mos keladi.
scenes.say: A simile compares using like or as: like a held breath. A metaphor says one thing is another. Personification gives human qualities to objects: the city swallowed him whole. Alliteration repeats a consonant: the silent street slept under a soft, silver sky. The repeated s sound adds a hush. Irony is a gap between what is said and what is meant.
scenes.say_uz: Simile like yoki as bilan qiyoslaydi. Metafora bir narsani boshqasi deb ataydi. Personification jonsiz narsaga inson xususiyatini beradi. Alliteration undoshni takrorlaydi: takrorlangan s tovushi sokinlik qo‘shadi. Irony aytilgan va nazarda tutilgan narsa orasidagi farqdir.

scenes.title: Xato: vositani nomlab to‘xtash
board: ✓ The metaphor of a locked door suggests she cannot escape her past.
✗ ‘Dark’ is a symbol of evil in every text.

examples.t: The metaphor of a locked door suggests that she cannot escape her past.
examples.uz: Qulflangan eshik metaforasi uning o‘tmishdan qochib qutula olmasligini bildiradi.

examples.t: Here, the dark room may symbolise fear.
examples.uz: Bu yerda qorong‘i xona qo‘rquvni ramziy ifodalashi mumkin.

scenes.say_native: Eng katta xato — faqat vositani atash: „The poet uses a metaphor“. Bu bilan hech narsa isbot bo‘lmaydi. To‘g‘ri tahlil vosita, dalil va ta’sirni birlashtiradi: „The metaphor of a locked door suggests that she cannot escape her past“. Ikkinchi xato — ramzni hamma joyda bir xil deb o‘ylash. „Dark“ har doim yomonlik emas; ba’zan u tinchlik yoki sir bo‘lishi mumkin. Shuning uchun „may symbolise“ — ramziy bo‘lishi mumkin — deb yozing. Uchinchi xato — vositalar ro‘yxatini tuzish. Uchta vositani yuzaki sanagandan ko‘ra, bittasini chuqur tahlil qilgan yaxshiroq.
scenes.say: The biggest mistake is naming a device and stopping: the poet uses a metaphor. That proves nothing. Combine the device, the evidence and the effect: the metaphor of a locked door suggests that she cannot escape her past. Also, a symbol is not fixed. Here, the dark room may symbolise fear. One device analysed well beats three that are merely listed.
scenes.say_uz: Eng katta xato — vositani atab to‘xtash. Bu hech narsani isbotlamaydi. Vosita, dalil va ta’sirni birlashtiring. Ramz ham qat’iy emas: bu yerda qorong‘i xona qo‘rquvni ifodalashi mumkin. Bitta vositani yaxshi tahlil qilish uchtasini sanashdan yaxshi.

scenes.title: Mashq: she’rdagi vositalar
board: and yet it reaches the sea.
The stones it wears away are slow to forgive.
scenes.say_native: Qisqa she’rni tinglang: „Daryo shoshilmaydi, shunga qaramay dengizga yetadi. U yeb ketgan toshlar kechirishga sekin.“ Uch savol: qaysi uslubiy vosita bor, uning ta’siri nima va mavzu qanday? Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Listen to a short poem. The river does not hurry, and yet it reaches the sea. The stones it wears away are slow to forgive. Which device do you find, what is its effect, and what theme does the poem suggest?
scenes.say_uz: Qisqa she’rni tinglang. Daryo shoshilmaydi, shunga qaramay dengizga yetadi. U yeb ketgan toshlar kechirishga sekin. Qaysi vosita bor, uning ta’siri nima va qanday mavzu ifodalanadi?

scenes.title: Javob: daryo she’ri
board: Effect: slow, human-like patience and cost

examples.t: The personification of the stones adds a human cost to the river’s progress.
examples.uz: Toshlarning jonlantirilishi daryo yutug‘iga inson qiymatini qo‘shadi.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob: „The poem personifies the stones, which are slow to forgive. This gives the river’s steady progress a human cost, as if patience can also hurt others. The poem therefore suggests that persistence has a price.“ Ikkinchi gapda „as if“ — go‘yo, taqqoslash. Bu yerda ikki g‘oya bor: daryo — sabr va barqarorlik, toshlar esa uning zarar yetkazgan tomoni. Yana bir imkoniyat — „does not hurry“ va „yet“ orasidagi ziddiyat: shoshilmaslik natijaga to‘sqinlik qilmaydi. Har xil talqin mumkin, lekin dalil — „slow to forgive“ — bo‘lsa, javob qabul qilinadi. Agar siz sabr mavzusini ham topgan bo‘lsangiz, bu ham to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: A model answer. The poem personifies the stones, which are slow to forgive. This gives the river's steady progress a human cost, as if patience can also hurt others. The poem therefore suggests that persistence has a price. Other readings are possible, such as a theme of patience, as long as you support them with evidence from the text.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javob. She’r toshlarni jonlantiradi, ular kechirishga sekin. Bu daryoning barqaror yurishiga inson qiymatini qo‘shadi, go‘yo sabr boshqalarni ham og‘ritishi mumkin. Demak, she’r qat’iyatning bahosi borligini ko‘rsatadi. Boshqa talqin ham mumkin, lekin matn dalili bo‘lsin.

scenes.title: Qisqa tahlil yozish: PEEL
board: Point: The writer presents loss through…

examples.t: The writer presents loss through the image of a stopped clock.
examples.uz: Muallif yo‘qotishni to‘xtagan soat obrazi orqali ko‘rsatadi.

examples.t: The clock, ‘stopped at ten past three’, implies that time froze at a moment of grief.
examples.uz: ‘Uch dan o‘n daqiqa o‘tganda to‘xtagan’ soat vaqt qayg‘u lahzasida qotib qolganini bildiradi.

examples.t: This links to the wider idea that the past can imprison us.
examples.uz: Bu o‘tmish bizni asir qilishi mumkin degan keng g‘oyaga bog‘lanadi.

scenes.say_native: Tahlil abzatsi uchun PEEL modeli qulay: Point — fikr, Evidence — dalil, Explanation — izoh, Link — bog‘lash. Avval aniq fikr: „The writer presents loss through the image of a stopped clock“. Keyin qisqa iqtibos: „stopped at ten past three“. Iqtibosni uzun qilmang, bir-ikki so‘z yetadi. Keyin izoh: „This implies that time froze at a moment of grief“. Oxirida mavzuga bog‘lang: „This links to the wider idea that the past can imprison us“. „Imply“ va „suggest“ — ishora qilmoq. Abzats besh-olti gapdan iborat bo‘lsa, yetarli. Bu o‘zbekcha insho tuzilishidan farq qiladi: sizdan har gapda dalil va tahlil kutiladi.
scenes.say: A paragraph can follow the PEEL pattern: point, evidence, explanation, link. Point: the writer presents loss through the image of a stopped clock. Evidence: use a short quotation, stopped at ten past three. Explanation: this implies that time froze at a moment of grief. Link: this connects to the wider idea that the past can imprison us.
scenes.say_uz: Abzats PEEL modeliga amal qilishi mumkin: fikr, dalil, izoh, bog‘lash. Fikr: muallif yo‘qotishni to‘xtagan soat orqali ko‘rsatadi. Dalil: qisqa iqtibos. Izoh: bu vaqt qayg‘u lahzasida qotib qolganini bildiradi. Bog‘lash: o‘tmish bizni asir qilishi mumkin degan keng g‘oyaga.

scenes.title: Xato: dalilsiz va uzun iqtibos
board: ✗ Copying three lines as a quotation

examples.t: The adjective ‘hollow’ conveys a sense of emptiness.
examples.uz: ‘Hollow’ sifati bo‘shliq tuyg‘usini yetkazadi.

examples.t: The word ‘kept’ in ‘kept its secret’ gives the clock a deliberate silence.
examples.uz: ‘Kept its secret’ dagi ‘kept’ so‘zi soatga ongli sukunat beradi.

scenes.say_native: Tahlilda uchta xato ko‘p uchraydi. Birinchisi — dalilsiz da’vo: „The writer is sad“. Qaysi so‘z buni ko‘rsatadi? „The adjective hollow conveys emptiness“ — mana to‘g‘ri tahlil. Ikkinchisi — uzun iqtibos: uch qatorni ko‘chirmang, faqat kerakli so‘zni oling. Uchinchisi — „In my opinion I think“ kabi ortiqcha so‘zlar; ular bir ma’noni ikki marta aytadi. Tahlil o‘z-o‘zidan sizning fikringiz. Yana bir kuchli odat: bitta so‘zga yaqin qarang. „Kept its secret“ dagi „kept“ so‘zi soatga ongli sukunat beradi. Bunday mayda kuzatuvlar tahlilni chuqurlashtiradi.
scenes.say: Three errors are common. First, a claim without evidence: the writer is sad. Which word shows it? The adjective hollow conveys a sense of emptiness. Second, long quotations. Take only the key word. Third, filler such as in my opinion I think. Look closely at single words: kept in kept its secret gives the clock a deliberate silence.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta xato ko‘p uchraydi. Birinchi: dalilsiz da’vo, qaysi so‘z buni ko‘rsatadi? Ikkinchi: uzun iqtibos, faqat kerakli so‘zni oling. Uchinchi: in my opinion I think kabi ortiqcha so‘zlar. Alohida so‘zlarga yaqin qarang.

scenes.title: Mashq: abzats yozing
board: Write a PEEL paragraph about the extract:
‘Dust lay on the piano like a held breath.’
scenes.say_native: „Pianino ustida chang ushlab turilgan nafasdek yotardi“ jumlasi haqida PEEL modelida qisqa abzats ayting yoki yozing. Fikr, qisqa iqtibos, izoh va mavzuga bog‘lash bo‘lsin. „Suggests“, „creates“ va „links to“ iboralaridan foydalaning. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Give a short PEEL paragraph about this sentence: dust lay on the piano like a held breath. Include a point, a short quotation, an explanation and a link to the theme. Use the verbs suggests, creates and links to.
scenes.say_uz: Dust lay on the piano like a held breath jumlasi haqida qisqa PEEL abzatsini ayting. Fikr, qisqa iqtibos, izoh va mavzuga bog‘lash bo‘lsin. Suggests, creates va links to fe’llaridan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Javob: namunaviy abzats
board: P: The writer personifies the silence.

examples.t: The simile ‘like a held breath’ suggests a house suspended in anxious waiting.
examples.uz: ‘Ushlab turilgan nafasdek’ qiyosi uyni tashvishli kutishda muallaq turgandek ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy abzats: „The writer creates an atmosphere of suspense through the simile ‘like a held breath’. This suggests a house suspended in anxious waiting, as though it is afraid to disturb the past. The image links to the wider theme of memory, since the past seems to be holding its breath until someone returns.“ Bu yerda „suspense“ — taranglik, „suspended“ — muallaq. Abzatsda to‘rtta qism ham bor: fikr, qisqa iqtibos, izoh va bog‘lash. Agar sizning variantingizda „simile“ so‘zi va uning ta’siri bo‘lsa, topshiriq yaxshi bajarilgan.
scenes.say: A model paragraph. The writer creates an atmosphere of suspense through the simile like a held breath. This suggests a house suspended in anxious waiting, as though it is afraid to disturb the past. The image links to the wider theme of memory, because the past seems to hold its breath until someone returns.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy abzats. Muallif ushlab turilgan nafasdek qiyosi orqali taranglik muhitini yaratadi. Bu uyni tashvishli kutishda muallaq turgandek ko‘rsatadi, go‘yo u o‘tmishni bezovta qilishdan qo‘rqadi. Obraz xotira mavzusiga bog‘lanadi.

scenes.title: Ehtiyotkor talqin tili
board: On the one hand… on the other…

examples.t: The final line may reflect the speaker’s acceptance of defeat.
examples.uz: Oxirgi misra so‘zlovchining mag‘lubiyatni qabul qilishini aks ettirishi mumkin.

examples.t: The ending seems to undercut the earlier optimism.
examples.uz: Yakun oldingi optimizmni susaytirayotgandek ko‘rinadi.

examples.t: This is reinforced by the repetition of the word ‘again’.
examples.uz: Buni ‘again’ so‘zining takrorlanishi mustahkamlaydi.

scenes.say_native: Adabiy tahlilda aniq isbotlab bo‘lmaydigan talqin ko‘p, shuning uchun ehtiyotkor til kerak. Fe’llar: „suggests“ — ishora qiladi, „implies“ — bildiradi, „evokes“ — uyg‘otadi, „conveys“ — yetkazadi, „reflects“ — aks ettiradi. Ehtiyotkor so‘zlar: „may“, „could“, „perhaps“, „seems to“. Masalan: „The final line may reflect the speaker’s acceptance of defeat“. Fikrni mustahkamlash uchun: „This is reinforced by the repetition of the word again“. Ikki talqinni solishtirish uchun: „On the one hand… on the other…“. Bu o‘zbekcha „aniq shunday“ qat’iyligidan farq qiladi: ingliz akademik tilida ehtiyotkorlik bilimsizlik emas, ishonchli uslub.
scenes.say: Literary interpretation is rarely certain, so we use careful language. Verbs: suggests, implies, evokes, conveys, reflects. Cautious words: may, could, perhaps, seems to. The final line may reflect the speaker's acceptance of defeat. To strengthen a point, say: this is reinforced by the repetition of the word again. To compare readings: on the one hand, on the other.
scenes.say_uz: Adabiy talqin kamdan-kam aniq bo‘ladi, shuning uchun ehtiyotkor til ishlatamiz. Fe’llar: suggests, implies, evokes, conveys, reflects. Ehtiyotkor so‘zlar: may, could, perhaps, seems to. Fikrni mustahkamlash uchun: this is reinforced by. Ikki talqinni solishtirish uchun: on the one hand, on the other.

scenes.title: Dialog: seminar muhokamasi
board: How does the tutor challenge her?
scenes.say_native: Endi seminarni tinglang. O‘qituvchi doktor Rid va talaba Leyla bir parcha haqida bahslashmoqda. Leyla nimani payqaydi va o‘qituvchi uning fikriga qanday e’tiroz bildiradi?
scenes.say: Dr Reed: Leila, what struck you about the opening? Leila: The narrator keeps repeating the word again. Again she waited, again she lied. It seems to suggest she is trapped in a cycle. Dr Reed: That is perceptive, but can we be sure she is trapped? Perhaps the repetition is her excuse. Leila: That is fair. The tone is calm, so it may be that she accepts the cycle rather than fights it.
scenes.say_uz: Doktor Rid: Leyla, boshlanishda sizni nima hayratga soldi? Leyla: Hikoyachi again so‘zini takrorlayveradi. Yana kutdi, yana yolg‘on gapirdi. Bu uning aylanib qolganini ko‘rsatayotgandek. Doktor Rid: Bu o‘tkir kuzatish, lekin aylanib qolganiga ishonchimiz komilmi? Balki takror uning bahonasidir. Leyla: Bu o‘rinli. Ohang sokin, shuning uchun u davrani qarshilik ko‘rsatish o‘rniga qabul qilgan bo‘lishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Mashq: seminar savollari
board: 3) How does she change her view?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: Leyla qaysi vositani payqadi? Ikkinchi: u qanday ta’sirni taklif qiladi? Uchinchi: u o‘z fikrini qanday o‘zgartiradi? Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Answer three questions about the seminar. Which device does Leila notice? What effect does she suggest? How does she refine her view at the end?
scenes.say_uz: Seminar bo‘yicha uchta savolga javob bering. Leyla qaysi vositani payqaydi? U qanday ta’sirni taklif qiladi? Oxirida o‘z fikrini qanday aniqlashtiradi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: seminar
board: 2) she is trapped in a cycle
3) she may accept the cycle rather than fight it

examples.t: It may be that she accepts the cycle rather than fights it.
examples.uz: U davrani qarshilik qilish o‘rniga qabul qilgan bo‘lishi mumkin.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi: Leyla „again“ so‘zining takrorlanishini payqadi, ya’ni „repetition“. Ikkinchi: u buni hikoyachi aylanishga tushib qolganini ko‘rsatadi deb talqin qildi. Uchinchi: doktor Rid „can we be sure?“ deb savol bergach, Leyla ohangni hisobga oldi va fikrini aniqlashtirdi: „it may be that she accepts the cycle“. E’tibor bering: Leyla bahslashmadi, balki dalil bilan talqinini kengaytirdi. „Perceptive“ — o‘tkir, „cycle“ — aylanma jarayon. Seminarda e’tiroz — hujum emas, fikrni chuqurlashtirish usuli; shunday javob berish bu ko‘nikmaning asosi.
scenes.say: One: Leila notices the repetition of again. Two: she suggests that the narrator is trapped in a cycle. Three: after Dr Reed asks can we be sure, Leila considers the calm tone and refines her view: it may be that she accepts the cycle. In a seminar, a challenge is not an attack. It is a way to deepen an interpretation.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Leyla again so‘zining takrorlanishini payqaydi. Ikki: hikoyachi aylanib qolgan deb taklif qiladi. Uch: doktor Rid ishonchimiz komilmi deb so‘ragach, Leyla ohangni hisobga olib fikrini aniqlashtiradi. Seminarda e’tiroz hujum emas, talqinni chuqurlashtirish usuli.

scenes.title: Dialog: ikki talaba, ikki talqin
board: Omar and Hana compare two readings
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog — ikki talaba bitta hikoyaning oxirini muhokama qiladi. Tinglang: ular qayerda kelishmaydi va nima haqida kelishadi?
scenes.say: Omar: I read the ending as hopeful. The window is open and morning light comes in. Hana: I see that, but the writer also says the light was thin and the room was cold. Omar: True, so the hope is fragile. Hana: Exactly. On the one hand the open window suggests freedom, on the other the cold implies it may not last. Omar: Then we both think the ending is ambiguous.
scenes.say_uz: Omar: Men oxirini umidli deb o‘qidim. Deraza ochiq va tong nuri kiryapti. Hana: Buni ko‘ryapman, lekin muallif yorug‘lik nozik va xona sovuq ham deydi. Omar: To‘g‘ri, demak umid mo‘rt. Hana: Aynan. Bir tomondan ochiq deraza erkinlikni, ikkinchi tomondan sovuq bu uzoq davom etmasligini bildiradi. Omar: Unda ikkalamiz ham yakunni noaniq deb hisoblaymiz.

scenes.title: Mashq: talqinlarni solishtiring
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: Omarning birinchi talqini qanday? Ikkinchi: Hana qanday dalil keltiradi? Uchinchi: ular qanday xulosaga keladi? Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Answer three questions. What is Omar's first reading? What evidence does Hana offer? What conclusion do they reach together?
scenes.say_uz: Uchta savolga javob bering. Omarning dastlabki talqini qanday? Hana qanday dalil keltiradi? Ular birgalikda qanday xulosaga keladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: ikki talqin
board: 1) The ending is hopeful (open window, morning light)
2) thin light and a cold room
3) The ending is ambiguous; hope is fragile

examples.t: The ending is ambiguous: hope is present, but it is fragile.
examples.uz: Yakun noaniq: umid bor, lekin u mo‘rt.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi: Omar yakunni umidli deb o‘qidi, chunki deraza ochiq va tong nuri kirmoqda. Ikkinchi: Hana yorug‘lik „thin“, ya’ni nozik, xona esa sovuq ekanini dalil qilib keltirdi. Uchinchi: ular yakun noaniq, umid esa mo‘rt degan xulosaga kelishdi. „Ambiguous“ — ikki ma’noli, noaniq, adabiy tahlilda bu kamchilik emas, ko‘pincha asarning boyligi. „Fragile“ — mo‘rt. E’tibor bering, talabalar bir-birini rad etmadi: „True“ va „Exactly“ deb tan olib, fikrni kengaytirdi. Shunday qilib, ikki qarama-qarshi dalil bitta chuqurroq xulosaga olib keldi.
scenes.say: One: Omar reads the ending as hopeful, because of the open window and morning light. Two: Hana points to the thin light and the cold room. Three: they conclude that the ending is ambiguous and the hope is fragile. Ambiguity is not a weakness in literature. It is often what makes a text rich. Notice how the students build on each other's points.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Omar yakunni umidli o‘qiydi, chunki deraza ochiq va tong nuri bor. Ikki: Hana nozik yorug‘lik va sovuq xonani ko‘rsatadi. Uch: ular yakun noaniq va umid mo‘rt degan xulosaga keladi. Noaniqlik adabiyotda kamchilik emas, ko‘pincha matnni boyitadi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: she’rni o‘qish va so‘zlar
board: Pause at punctuation, not at line ends

examples.t: A metaphor is a figure of speech.
examples.uz: Metafora — nutq figurasi.

examples.t: The poem’s imagery is vivid and unsettling.
examples.uz: She’rning obrazlari yorqin va bezovta qiluvchi.

scenes.say_native: Ba’zi atamalar talaffuzda qiyin. „Metaphor“ — urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda, metafo. „Imagery“ — „imidjri“ kabi, urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda, o‘rtadagi unli deyarli eshitilmaydi. „Alliteration“ — urg‘u „rei“ bo‘g‘inida: alitereishn. She’r o‘qiyotganda esa qoida: pauzani misra oxirida emas, tinish belgisida qiling. Agar misra nuqta bilan tugamasa, ovozingiz to‘xtamasdan davom etsin. She’r o‘qishda sekin va aniq gapiring, muhim so‘zlarga urg‘u bering. Bu o‘zbekcha she’rxonlikdan farq qiladi, chunki biz ko‘pincha har misrani alohida to‘xtatamiz, inglizcha o‘qishda esa jumla ma’nosi birinchi o‘rinda turadi.
scenes.say: Some terms are tricky. Metaphor has the stress on the first syllable. Imagery also has first-syllable stress, and the middle vowel is very weak. Alliteration has the stress on the third syllable, ray. When you read a poem aloud, pause at punctuation, not automatically at the end of each line. Speak slowly and stress the key words.
scenes.say_uz: Ba’zi atamalar qiyin. Metaphor va imagery da urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda. Alliteration da urg‘u uchinchi bo‘g‘in ray da. She’r o‘qiganda pauzani har misra oxirida emas, tinish belgisida qiling. Sekin gapiring va muhim so‘zlarga urg‘u bering.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: mustaqil tahlil
board: Extract: The city swallowed him whole. By morning he was a coat among coats, a face the crowd had already forgotten.
Say 5 sentences: theme · device · effect · evidence · link
scenes.say_native: Yangi parchani tahlil qiling: „Shahar uni butunlay yutib yubordi. Ertalabga kelib u paltolar orasidagi bitta palto, olomon allaqachon unutgan yuz edi.“ Besh gapda mavzu, vosita, uning ta’siri, dalil va keng mavzuga bog‘lashni ayting. „Suggests“ va „may“ so‘zlarini ishlating. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Analyse a new extract. The city swallowed him whole. By morning he was a coat among coats, a face the crowd had already forgotten. In five sentences, cover theme, device, effect, evidence and a link. Use suggests and may.
scenes.say_uz: Yangi parchani tahlil qiling. Shahar uni butunlay yutib yubordi. Ertalabga kelib u paltolar orasidagi bitta palto, olomon allaqachon unutgan yuz edi. Besh gapda mavzu, vosita, ta’sir, dalil va bog‘lashni ayting.

scenes.title: Javob: shahar va yolg‘izlik
board: Theme: anonymity and loss of identity

examples.t: The metaphor ‘a coat among coats’ reduces the man to an anonymous object.
examples.uz: ‘Paltolar orasidagi palto’ metaforasi odamni anonim buyumga aylantiradi.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob: „The extract explores anonymity in the modern city. The personification of the city, which ‘swallowed him whole’, suggests a powerful force that consumes individuals. The metaphor ‘a coat among coats’ reduces the man to an anonymous object, and the forgotten ‘face’ implies that nobody notices him. This may reflect a wider fear that city life erases identity.“ „Swallow“ — yutmoq, „consume“ — yutib yubormoq, „anonymity“ — noma’lumlik, shaxssizlik. Javobda mavzu, ikkita vosita, ta’sir va bog‘lash bor. Agar sizning variantingizda bitta vosita va uning ta’siri to‘g‘ri tahlil qilingan bo‘lsa, ham yaxshi.
scenes.say: A model answer. The extract explores anonymity in the modern city. The personification of the city, which swallowed him whole, suggests a powerful force that consumes individuals. The metaphor a coat among coats reduces the man to an anonymous object, and the forgotten face implies that nobody notices him. This may reflect a wider fear that city life erases identity.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javob. Parcha zamonaviy shahardagi shaxssizlikni o‘rganadi. Shaharning jonlantirilishi uni yutib yuborgan, ya’ni insonlarni singdiruvchi kuchli kuch deb ko‘rsatadi. Paltolar orasidagi palto metaforasi odamni anonim buyumga aylantiradi. Bu shahar hayoti shaxsiyatni o‘chirib yuboradi degan qo‘rquvni aks ettirishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Takrorlash
scenes.say_native: Bugungi darsni jamlaymiz. Mavzu — hayot haqidagi fikr, topic emas; obraz esa sezgilarga ta’sir qiladi. Hikoyachini muallifdan ajrating, shaxsini va ohangini tasvirlang, ishonchsiz bo‘lishi mumkinligini unutmang. Uslubiy vositani atash yetarli emas: vosita, dalil va ta’sirni birga ayting. Abzatsni PEEL bilan quring va talqinda „suggests“, „may“ kabi ehtiyotkor so‘zlardan foydalaning. Seminarda e’tiroz fikrni chuqurlashtiradi. Oxirgi maslahat: bitta so‘zga diqqat bilan qarash ko‘pincha eng yaxshi tahlilni beradi.
scenes.say: Let's review. A theme is an idea, not a topic, and imagery appeals to the senses. Separate the narrator from the author and describe the voice and tone. Do not just name a device. Give the evidence and the effect. Build paragraphs with PEEL and use careful words like suggests and may. And remember that close attention to a single word often gives the best analysis.
scenes.say_uz: Takrorlaymiz. Mavzu — g‘oya, topic emas, obraz esa sezgilarga ta’sir qiladi. Hikoyachini muallifdan ajrating. Vositani shunchaki atamang, dalil va ta’sirni bering. Abzatsni PEEL bilan quring va suggests, may kabi ehtiyotkor so‘zlarni ishlating. Bitta so‘zga diqqat qilish ko‘pincha eng yaxshi tahlilni beradi.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Homework: analyse a short poem or story extract
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa: qisqa she’r yoki hikoya parchasini tanlang va yuz ellik-ikki yuz so‘zlik tahlil yozing. Unda bitta mavzu, ikkita uslubiy vosita va uchta qisqa iqtibos bo‘lsin. Abzatslarni PEEL bilan quring va „suggests“, „may“ kabi so‘zlarni ishlating. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir vositaning ta’siri izohlangan va hikoyachi yoki ohang haqida kamida bitta gap bor. Keyingi darsda rasmiy imtihonning yozish qismini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to analyse a short poem or a story extract in a hundred and fifty to two hundred words. Include one theme, two devices and three short quotations. Structure your paragraphs with PEEL. Next time we prepare for the writing part of an official exam.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifa: qisqa she’r yoki hikoya parchasini yuz ellik-ikki yuz so‘zda tahlil qiling. Bitta mavzu, ikkita vosita va uchta qisqa iqtibos bo‘lsin. Abzatslarni PEEL bilan quring. Keyingi safar rasmiy imtihonning yozish qismiga tayyorlanamiz.

homework_uz: Qisqa she’r yoki hikoya parchasini 150–200 so‘zda tahlil qiling: bitta mavzu, ikkita uslubiy vosita, uchta qisqa iqtibos, PEEL tuzilishi va “suggests”, “may” kabi ehtiyotkor so‘zlar. Keyingi darsda rasmiy imtihonning yozish qismini o‘rganamiz.

quiz.q: Which is a theme, not just a topic?
quiz.why_uz: Mavzu — hayot haqidagi fikr, topic esa faqat soha.

options: The rhyme scheme of a poem
Language that appeals to the senses

quiz.q: ‘The city swallowed him whole.’ is an example of…

options: Dust lay on the piano like a held breath.
quiz.why_uz: Simile like yoki as bilan qiyoslaydi.

quiz.q: Which is the best analytical sentence?
options: The metaphor of a locked door suggests she cannot escape her past.
The poem is about a door.
quiz.why_uz: Vosita, dalil va ta’sir birga berilgan.

quiz.q: Why is it wrong to write ‘The author hates her mother’ about a first-person story?
options: The narrator is a voice the author created
Mothers are not allowed in stories

quiz.why_uz: Ishonchsiz hikoyachi xato qilishi yoki yolg‘on aytishi mumkin.

quiz.q: Which phrase is the most cautious?
Where should you pause when reading a poem aloud?
quiz.why_uz: Pauza tinish belgisida, misra oxirida avtomatik emas.
